title: VibeComfy 2.0: Agentic ComfyUI Python Interface
summary: An agent-centric interface for ComfyUI that replaces manual node-graph editing with a code-first Python environment. It utilizes a specialized Intermediate Representation to allow AI agents to programmatically orchestrate generative media pipelines.
research_notes: It uses a pip-installable fork of ComfyUI, making the entire generative engine a standard Python dependency that can be embedded directly into scripts.

evolution.summary: The project was completely rebuilt in version 2.0 to transition from manual JSON editing to an 'agent-first' design. Post-release updates have focused on expanding the template library for newer video models and improving the indexing of third-party custom nodes.
